title: showcase: no stock page hosts the record_header / record_more / record_related action locations for showcase_task, so records-forms.action-location-matrix A1 and A3 cannot be run on any boot (parks #22017 row 7)
body:
Filed by PM seat `domain:devx#2` (`session_01VF48aw8RPG6wzDnMgp6rtw`) from PR #22029's dev report on #22017 (row 7). The seat re-read the cited files on `origin/main` before filing. ⛔ Filed bare: grading and routing are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Filing gate: ③ a direct task from a maintainer ruling.** #22017 is the close-out of the 17.7 pre-release runs, approved by the maintainer as 「同意，动手」 (quoted on #22017). Its done-when says, verbatim: "A row's answer can be 'this needs a product change': that becomes its own card, and this row parks on it." Row 7 is that row.

## What is measured

- `records-forms.action-location-matrix` asserts actions at the `record_header`, `record_more` and `record_related` locations. All three are declared in `ACTION_LOCATIONS` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` about `:667`–`:669`), and `record_related`'s meaning was enforced by #20937 (PR #20948).
- **No stock showcase surface hosts them for `showcase_task`** (`examples/app-showcase`, read on `origin/main`):
  - `src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts` is a kind `'full'` page with no record header node;
  - `src/ui/pages/project-detail.page.ts` renders its tasks through `record:line_items` instead of the synthesized Tasks related list.
- So leg A1's three variants, and leg A3's url and api dispatch, are `blocked(fixture)` on every boot. Revision 7 (#21797) already scored them that way, and #21797's report named it breach B-1 without filing it. PR #22029 records it as a knownGap that parks on this card.

## Done when

- A stock showcase surface puts a `showcase_task` record under a record header (with its ⋯ overflow), and a parent record page renders the synthesized Tasks related list.
- With that, `records-forms.action-location-matrix` A1 (three variants) and A3 (url / api) can be run on a stock showcase boot.
- The item's knownGap is lifted in the same PR, or in a follow-up that cites it.

The shape of the fix (a new task page, or recomposing the existing ones) is the implementing lane's call. ⛔ It must not drop `record:line_items` from project-detail if another checklist item reads it; check before changing it.

## Reader

Triage, for routing: `examples/app-showcase` is the landing point. Then the implementing lane. #22017's row 7 parks here; that card closes through PR #22029 independently of this one.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, sorted by update: 「showcase page hosting record_header record_more record_related action locations for showcase_task, action-location-matrix」 → 3 hits, all closed:
- #21142 (project-detail's `record:line_items` column keys);
- #20937 (`record_related` had no read site; resolved by enforcing it, PR #20948);
- #6739 (`showcase_new_task` targets a page).

None asks for a host surface for these locations.
